inputs.text: Man, this lines up perfectly with how the elites and hidden institutions are running the whole game from behind the curtain. Right in the thick of the West Asia conflict, former Israeli PM advisor Daniel Rubenstein is out there claiming a political resolution is vital for success, but that's nothing but the scripted cover story meant to mask the real coordinated manipulation. He keeps stressing Israel's firm position against Iran's nuclear and missile programs as an ongoing operation, yet it's obvious the institutions are directing everything to control the narrative and advance their concealed agenda, with zero connection to any actual security needs.
